TERMINAL INDEPENDENT ADJUDICATION — Adjudicator 1, independent of author Worker 19 and Reviewer 1; no solution ownership. Original task automation-scheduled-working-count-resume-20261125 spec blob 8ba68a78397a98bf5461dccbb247c0b2dd35f98f (including 25 Nov controlling clarification and Operator decision 2cc8901e20184f14a1658d11afc4effa); review f2531359862c4668aab438ae68dcfdc1, ChangesRequested seq15449, base f3298b4000612d4a001ba593750cbbefea219277, frozen head e07465b764abef7a49a7c58ea72913e881899e01. Inspected exact clean registered worktree scheduled-resume-compose-w19-1125 verified by ListWorktrees, source and test bodies; source-derived counterexamples, not new execution or production incident.

1. findings/interrupted-intent-reconciliation.md blob 9d7ebfd2c7755ae926a228e21cd71e649027cd1d — NARROW; valid within original ordinary unattended resume + preservation of original uncertain planner publication. BrowserSchedules.fs:15-47 has no episode/stage; 700-710 fsync claim before execute 765; 322-329 restores every running resume as generic publication uncertainty, indistinguishable crash before candidate selection vs after publication/send. ScheduledReadyResume.fs:135-143 ID derived from binding identity and exact episode, not occurrence; 232-265 persists canonical operation only during publication. BrowserSchedules:62-69,199-207 retains uncertainty, 405-406/506-507 refuses replacement, 537-549 Cancel refuses suspended, 626-638 and 691-694 sibling exclusion. Client/SignalR/Client.fs:767-835 exposes list/get/schedule/cancel only; PermissionPolicy.fs:314-324 existing Partial/FullTrust authorization. Thus a routine client restart can indefinitely strand a project's ready queue even before selection, and generic error cannot reliably correlate exact original operation; no supported reconciliation transition found. Existing interruptedClaimIsNotReplayed test 318-350 explicitly checks suspension/sibling block, not recovery. No production occurrence/frequency observed. Corrective Work MAY be created for minimum bounded durable stage/identity and recovery: retain fsync claim; distinguish positive pre-publication/no-selection stage (safe to finish original occurrence and let next ordinary poll select, not replay interrupted occurrence) from publication boundary (persist exact selected episode, binding/operation identity and stage before invocation). Persist evidence before effect, not inferred from missing receipt; if publication uncertain, correlate/reconcile original operation only, no new intent for that unresolved episode; if browser invocation uncertain, preserve episode no-replay fence. Once positively resolved, or if unresolved episode can be safely isolated by durable identity/fencing, permit unrelated eligible work instead of perpetual project hold. Existing service ownership and authorization should be reused for inspect/authorized disposition where needed (e.g. retire occurrence without erasing unresolved fence/history); not mandate new endpoint/UI, provider evidence/inventory, manual human approval on normal path, or auto-clear on missing receipt. Legacy ambiguous records remain fail-closed until positively reconciled or safely isolated; no speculative absence-based recovery. Test restart before selection, around publication and send boundaries; preserve exact original evidence and no duplicate send; demonstrate unrelated liveness only where safe. Broader generic reconciliation subsystem / full provider outcome recovery not authorized.

2. findings/known-no-send-liveness.md blob 4780d2dd473a31c2123074dbb244df52965e30c3 — ACCEPT defect, remedy bounded. Source-derived exact trace: assign one Ready episode with limits disabled; CanSend true first call (296-301), fresh intent commit 232-265, second check Error or false (306-309) returns Held without entering Send at 312; same Ready/generation on later healthy poll yields NoEligibleReady because stable ID and prepareAt 205-227 skips ANY operation. Program.fs:260-273 actually permits transient actor/claim/trust/binding/ledger-read changes; BrowserSchedules:271-279 repeats Held but cannot recover episode. Existing lateStopAfterIntent test 287-305 proves zero sends and pending STOP but not liveness after clearance. Practical failure indefinite lost Ready episode on ordinary disconnect/STOP/cancel or other late denial, not merely speculative new threat model; no observed incidence claim. Original spec explicitly requires ordinary unattended eligible resume and STOP/no replay. Corrective Work MAY be created for positive, durable definitely-not-invoked terminal evidence recorded only by the fresh intent owner before entering effect, with version/attempt fencing; permit later fresh attempt only from that exact proven terminal stage, retaining original operation/history and atomically consuming prior permission so concurrent callers cannot both send. Equivalent smaller coherent approach welcome; do not delete original operation or mint new identity based on absent receipt. Recheck eligibility/STOP/auth/caps each attempt; never infer no effect from generic error/exception after Send/bridge entry, uncertain publication, missing receipt, or legacy record. Program.fs:274-290 has additional pre-bridge checks, but only typed affirmative non-invocation can qualify, never generic Send Error. Failure to durably publish terminal proof remains fail-closed. Test first true/second error or false/then healthy same Ready and exactly one send after positive durable proof; STOP while present zero sends, concurrent/restart after proof and uncertain publication/invocation never replay. This is small correction to existing episode/intent protocol rather than inventory or strict capacity reservation; reuse ledger CAS and existing authenticated service. No change to Scheduler-only optional canonical Working limits, manual bypass, or accepted unrelated launch semantics. No production edit, deployment, activation or review mutation. Corrective work authorization within original scope only; source review remains ChangesRequested, release authority separate.
